description: This Java source file defines the 'AuthActivity' class used within an Android autofill service to handle authentication dialogs. It manages user responses ('Yes' or 'No') and constructs intents for further autofill responses or dataset authentication, including static methods for generating intent senders for these purposes.

classes.name: AuthActivity
classes.description: An Android activity employed for autofill authentication, presenting options to accept or decline, and generating appropriate responses for the autofill framework.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the view, and sets click listeners for the Yes and No buttons.

methods.name: onYes
methods.description: Handles the confirmation, prepares the autofill response including dataset or hints, and finishes with a successful result.

methods.name: onNo
methods.description: Handles cancellation, sets the result as canceled, and finishes the activity.

methods.name: newIntentSenderForDataset
methods.description: Creates an IntentSender for a dataset; used to trigger autofill with a specific dataset.

methods.name: newIntentSenderForResponse
methods.description: Creates an IntentSender for an autofill response, with hints, IDs, and optional inline suggestions.

methods.name: newIntentSender
methods.description: Private static helper that constructs the IntentSender with provided parameters for dataset or response.
